materials.story: Misfortune often creeps in quietly, and by the time you perceive it, it has already swelled into a calamity that engulfs the world. "The death knell sounds at destiny's cessation."

materials.name: Echoing Wail
sources: Black Tide Creatures at Equilibrium Level 2 or higher
materials.description: A fractured carapace from black tide creatures. Normal material used for enhancement.
materials.story: Grotesque heads roar, ragged blades keen enough to sunder all, while the genesis of the scourge still lurks, veiled in the shadows and shrouded by the mists of death. "Why do you lament alone at the gravestone?"

materials.name: Eternal Lament
sources: Black Tide Creature at Equilibrium Level 4 or higher
materials.description: A crystal born from the demise of black tide creatures. Advanced material used for enhancement.
materials.story: Born of the void and destined to return to the void. A contorted existence wrought by decay, fated to wander the desolate earth purposelessly. "Its life is one of ruin and sorrow."

materials.name: Whimsy Wax
materials.description: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A crude material used for enhancement.
materials.story: In the primal wilds, a mother asked her child, "Did you break your father's bow?" The child answered, "No, it must have been someone else." "No one else has ever stepped foot in this cave," the mother said. "If it wasn't you, then it must have been me." The child continued, "A gremlin did it. I saw it with my own eyes, but only kids can see them, so that's why you didn't." The mother laughed. "Fine then, why would a gremlin break your father's bow?" The child said calmly, "Father probably stepped on its nest. You adults can't see gremlins, so you're always breaking their homes." Whether this talk actually happened is irrelevant. The truth it holds is undeniable — the first stories were born from the imagination of a child. For billions of years since, those same fantasies have continued to change the world. "With stories, we are able to escape from reality."

materials.name: Dreamweave Steel
sources: Drops from imagenated creatures at Equilibrium Level 2
materials.description: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. A normal material used for enhancement.
materials.story: Remember the old story? An officer pointed at a painting that exposed his atrocities and asked, "Did you paint this?" The artist smiled and replied, "No, you did." Art that tries to represent reality cannot simply copy it. The shallow surface of reality can never capture its profound, intangible essence. Consider a fallen soldier. If you only paint their likeness, they are just one more face among the nameless dead. But if you look past the surface to find the invisible honor, courage, rage, and regret, that is when you truly reach their reality. Only then will people know that this soldier was not just another statistic. This was someone who once brought the pulse of life to the mountains, the waters, and the homes they left behind. "With stories, we are able to fight back against evil."

materials.name: Lucid Awl
sources: Drops from imagenated creatures at Equilibrium Level 4
materials.description: A Wishpower fragment from an imagenated creature. An advanced material used for enhancement.
materials.story: Every story worth taking seriously shares the same theme: "How to live the one life we're given." Life is so short that even the greatest sages are suddenly tossed into this world, forced to experience a lifetime without any preparation. That is why no one ever lives a perfect life. There are always regrets, always moments wasted. But luckily, we have stories. In stories, creators and readers share a different life. In stories, the human experience is continuously extended. And in stories, we can reach immortality from within our finite cages. "With stories, we are able to live a thousand lifetimes."

materials.name: Lil' Twisty Bubble Gum
materials.description: A tasty and cheap Punklorde snack. Can be used to Superimpose the Light Cone "Before the Tutorial Mission Starts."
materials.story: A candy favored by a certain Stellaron Hunter. It contains rocket tree gum, and the crispy sound of bubbles popping is absolutely irresistible. "Pop!"

materials.name: Exorcismal Fulu
materials.description: The special talisman used by the Ten-Lords Commission to suppress heliobi. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "Hey, Over Here."
materials.story: "Decree of Nine Chapters, myriad spirits concealed."

materials.name: Clockwork Inspiration Notebook
materials.description: A handbook that contains the Watchmaker's inspiration for his works. Can be used for the Superimposition of the Light Cone "For Tomorrow's Journey."
materials.story: The initial director of Dreamjoy Memoir left this on the desk. It's filled with messy drafts, cryptic wording, indecipherable handwriting, and a Clockie's smile... The contents of this handbook bear the past of an entire world.

materials.name: Music Disc
materials.description: The disc used during a band's performance. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "Ninja Record: Sound Hunt."
materials.story: "The best way to record memories."

materials.name: Physical Game Cartridge
materials.description: A plug-and-play cartridge. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "The Great Cosmic Enterprise."
materials.story: Even with today's advanced data transfer technology, some developers still prefer cartridges as their game medium, just like writers savoring the sensation of pen on paper.

materials.name: Chrysos Spoon
materials.description: A legendary cooking utensil used by fairies. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "The Forever Victual."
materials.story: "—With the power to control most of the Membrance Maze!"

materials.name: Flawed Recollection
materials.description: A flawed, fragile crystalline flower of Remembrance. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone "Fly Into a Pink Tomorrow."
materials.story: "That genuine shiver when crystal flowers fall... That's the 'mover of life.'"

materials.name: Commemorative Cartridge
materials.description: A game cartridge featuring the Baseball Raccoon avatar, the proof of a popular streamer. It can be used to superimpose the Light Cone: "Tomorrow, Together."
materials.story: "A game we all produced together."

materials.name: Celebration Champagne
materials.description: The crisp pop of a champagne cork is like a victory salute. Can superimpose the Light Cone "Race to the Horizon."
materials.story: In the euphoria of victory, it is uncorked atop the podium, shaken, and sent spraying into the sky. A fragrant, fruity rain. "Pop!"

materials.name: Solid Water
sources: Storage Zone: Baryons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Compound composed of hydrogen and oxygen, essential to support carbon-based life. Keeping it in the solid state makes it easy to carry. "...Isn't it ice?" "No, no, no. Ice is ice, this is water, just in the solid state." "...Isn't that the definition of ice?"

materials.name: Basic Ingredients
sources: Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Ingredients that keep you fed but taste less than ideal. Not particularly good, but is edible. "Can I eat it? Is it good? What do I eat it with?"

materials.name: Phlogiston
sources: Backwater Pass: Flamespawns or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Particles that form the flame. Genius Society #2 Harald Punch proved its existence, but #3 Nyul Iman disproved it. #7 Bohdan overthrew Iman's conclusion and proved it again before getting killed by #4 Polka Kakamond days after announcing Phlogiston's existence. "Does it exist or not? We're not interested, frankly speaking."

materials.name: Metal
sources: Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: A substance abundant in planets' crust and the ocean. Very useful, very handy. "I've been to a planet where the locals consume metals to get superpowers. Please don't do that at home, as most metals are not digestible by humans."

materials.name: Gaseous Liquid
sources: Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Is it fog, rain, or wind? You can't tell if it's still in the container without lifting the lid. "The answer my friend, is blowing in the gaseous liquid..." "The answer is blowing in the gaseous liquid."

materials.name: Seed
sources: Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Reproductive units unique to plants. Most of them symbolize life, and some of them taste pretty good. "Sow one in the spring, harvest a thousand in the autumn."

materials.name: Discarded Ingenium Parts
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: To a bystander, it's just trash. To a craftsman, it's leftover materials. To a recycler, it's credits. Only skilled artisans who truly understand the art of ingenia can see valuable treasures in what others deem wasteful. "It is said that in the Great Trial of the Furnace, to challenge Mr. Yingxing, they gave him a pile of defective products and waste. But after a day and night, he crafted a lifelike mechanical lion that moved as if it was alive."

materials.name: Human-Height Auspicious Crops
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: The robust and bountiful rice ears are astonishingly as tall as a person. In certain agricultural and pastoral delves of Xianzhou, such towering auspicious crops can be found everywhere. "The scholars who planted them hoped that people would never have to experience the feeling of hunger again."

materials.name: Tranquility
sources: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Allseer" or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: After a long day of work or school, you savagely dive onto your bed on a Friday night, ready to hide there for the next two days. "Turn off your cell phone, and if anyone asks on Monday why they couldn't reach you, just say your cell phone ran away from home, and you just managed to talk it into coming back."

materials.name: Broken Dreams
sources: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Allseer" or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Shards like this can be found everywhere throughout Penacony. They once belonged to broken hearts. "In the realm of black dreams I sleep, where distinctions of right or wrong are buried deep."

materials.name: Rusty Gear
sources: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Gears themselves are not rare, but finding gears that meet the specifications is no easy task. With rapid advancements in technology, these outdated parts are being discarded in large quantities. "The best gear is always the one that fits perfectly."

materials.name: Distinctive Tattered Feather
sources: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
materials.description: Tier 1 Synthesis Material
materials.story: A feather adorned with the Titan Aquila's symbol, often found on cliff faces near the heavens. Some believe these are ciliary feathers shed by Aquila, the hundred-eyed giant bird, while others think they are remnants of birds of prey that soared too high, caught in Aquila's gaze, and met their demise. In ancient times, Aquila's disciples collected these feathers in bulk, using them to craft the ceremonial priestly miter. Notably, the Titan symbol on the feathers fades if left exposed to the night air for too long. "If my love for you could be measured... it would surpass the number of Aquila's eyelashes!" "...Though, now that I think about it, does the hundred-eyed giant bird even have eyelashes?"

materials.name: Mechanical Parts
sources: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Essential components of all machines with strange shapes and specific functions. Without them, nothing can be made. "With the same parts, Screwllum can make entire planets and create cyborgs. But you can only make me a watch that runs seven seconds late every day." "Seven seconds is good enough! Just a hair later than the clocks they use in observatories."

materials.name: Virtual Particle
sources: Storage Zone: Baryons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Tiny particles commonly found in the universe but cannot be observed in theory. Scientists are good at transforming theories into reality. "I've got a virtual particle and an anti virtual particle here. How do we turn them into a real particle and a real antiparticle? Now, look closely..."

materials.name: Protein Rice
sources: Storage Zone: Voidranger: Reavers or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in the Herta Space Station
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Nature's gift to human society, friend of mankind, savior of lives. Smooth as egg white and full of protein. "Every grain costs sweat and blood."

materials.name: Feather of Flame
sources: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Warm dark feather with a weak ember at its tip. Sparks trail the feather as it's waved around. "The legend of the Phoenix spreads far throughout the entire universe..."

materials.name: Core of Ice
sources: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Shattered ice fallen from the stars. The frosty mist it emits when removed from a specialized canister looks like the breath of wintertime. "Zoom in on a snowflake 100 times and behold the wonder of nature."

materials.name: Eye of Lightning
sources: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: An electric ball made from captured lightning. If its balance is tipped by a conductor, it emits a lightning ball. "A genius in the past wanted to use Eye of Lightning to search for aliens. For this, Nous cast their gaze upon her. Not sure which is the bigger win: Found aliens for real or got noticed by Nous?"

materials.name: Vortex of Wind
sources: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: The eye of the storm remains stagnant. Even when put in vacuum, the grains involved in the vortex continue to revolve around the eye of the storm. "Look, they won't stop no matter what happens. They just keep whirling. You know what that reminds me of?" "Trailblazing!" "...That's right, Pom-Pom. Promise me that our trailblazing journey will never come to a stop."

materials.name: Quantum Ripples
sources: Rivet Town: Imaginary Weavers or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Ripples in the Sea of Quanta. Although called "ripples," they are in fact the most basic form of energy fluctuation. "Time, there's so much time." "All the time there is."

materials.name: Leaf of Imaginary
sources: Backwater Pass: Flamespawns or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: A leaf of unknown origin. It doesn't belong to any plant and is more of a representation of something more abstract. The ancient light nourishes the leaf through its veins, displaying its faded but remnant power. "One leaf, one world."

materials.name: Meteoric Alloy
sources: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies
Found in destructible objects in Jarilo-VI
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Resilient meteoric ironsand. Its tenacity is far superior to solid boulders. "Let's grab as much as we can. Qlipoth will need them." "I have no idea whether the Aeon need them or not. All I know is that the IPC will pay big bucks for them."

materials.name: Jade Abacus Unit
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: The most essential component of jade abaci, commonly used in the final step of installation. "Pick one, they are all outdated models. But once installed, they will undoubtedly bring a soul-like essence to your machines."

materials.name: Extract of Medicinal Herbs
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Medicinal herbs are the foundation of Xianzhou's medical practice, and these extracts capture the active ingredients from various herbs, enhancing their medicinal efficacy in leaps and bounds. "The value of 'tradition' lies in its ability to evolve and progress, rather than remaining stagnant."

materials.name: Tian Dong
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: While plants of the Tian Dong genus typically grow on land, Tian Dong plants of Scalegorge Waterscape stand out by extensively inhabiting the coastal areas of the Lunarescent Depths. Although artificial cultivation techniques for Tian Dong have become quite prevalent, there are still many who believe in the superstition that "wild plants have stronger medicinal properties," causing significant trouble for the Pearlkeepers. "Plunderers of Tian Dong, to the Shackling Prison they will go."

materials.name: Confounding
sources: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: I've never been outstanding since I was a kid. I barely met the requirements to get into college, and I barely earned enough credits to obtain my degree. Now, I'm sitting at my desk, contemplating how to explain my understanding of "confusion" to you, but am I really worthy of showering you with my superficial understanding? And do you really need to listen to all this broken gibberish of mine? I don't know the answer. "Anyway, I hope you enjoy yourself."

materials.name: Hunger
sources: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: In Penacony, "hunger" is an expensive spice that can make any food in the Dreamscape irresistible. In the world beyond dreams, "hunger" is the smile on the lips of death. "They say hunger is the best seasoning, but I just want to fill my stomach."

materials.name: Old Molar
sources: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: No one knows the origin of this molar. The person selling it claims this extremely anachronistic item was found on the battlefield of the Emperor's War, infused by a bygone era of craftsmanship and defiance now lost in modern times. "It serves as the growth rings of inorganic life."

materials.name: Bough of Thought
sources: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: A glowing bough with branches sprawling unrestrained in every direction, resembling the organic divergence of thought. It is born in a quiet corner of the Grove where scholars often drift into contemplative dazes. Though lacking any practical use, Cerces appears particularly fond of such curiosities. Legend has it that the Titan would select the bough with the most intricate branching and wear it atop their head as an ornament. "For a long time, I've been going to bed early, yet it does little to quiet my restless mind. It feels as though the thoughts from a past life have been reborn within me... At some point, I began to notice a cluster of intertwined branches outside my window."

materials.name: Deep Marrow Rock Salt
sources: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
materials.description: Tier 2 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Salt crystals unearthed from the depths of the rift valley, revered by the farmers who toil on the land. Many keep one of these crystals in their homes, treasuring it as the "bared spine marrow of Georios," a generous gift to the farmers. When reclaiming barren land, just a small sprinkling of this rock salt is enough to transform the barren soil into fertile ground, breathing life back into the earth. "Non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic, non-organic fertilizer is the best!"

materials.name: Strange Matter of Destruction
sources: Storage Zone: Voidranger: Reavers or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Strange matter that seems to possess the power of destruction. Resembling fire but not quite, it is neither cold nor hot and will damage anything that comes into contact with it for over 12 seconds. Could be the Antimatter Legion's version of trash. "Creatures that received blessing from Nanook all have twisted appearances."

materials.name: Ambergris of Abundance
sources: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Jelly-like substance that contains the power of Abundance. Firm but not stiff, with notes of fragrance, it fills your heart with hope the moment it touches your fingertip. Do not ask what it's made of. "It gives you longevity and abundance, dispelling misfortune and illness."

materials.name: Stone of The Hunt
materials.description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Small stone with the power of The Hunt. As if guided by someone's will, it moves by itself towards a certain direction. Sounds like what a magnet would do? I assure you it is not. "The destination lies where my arrow is heading."

materials.name: Preservation Construction Material
sources: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Construction materials that seem to possess the power of Preservation. When mixed with water it forms a paste, when exposed to air it turns rock-hard. Please do not use together with Solid Water. "I regret to say that Intelligentsia Guild's research on the material used to build the Subspace Crystalline Barrier by Amber Lord still needs time to reveal its nature." "I'm sure it's not cement — am I right, Taravan?"

materials.name: Hard Chip of Nihility
sources: Rivet Town: Imaginary Weavers or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
materials.story: A chip made of iron that seems to possess the power of Nihility. It may have been a coin that people use to buy things. But apparently, as the engravings on it fade away, its value went with them. "I don't know what I'm writing between these quotation marks. What's the point of this item description? My life is meaningless, so is this piece of flavor text."

materials.name: Tree Bark of Erudition
sources: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Dried tree bark that seems to possess the power of Erudition. Its creases tell the story of the years passed and the wisdom of nature. It says a lot more when beaten into pulp used for papermaking. "The wisdom of mankind is contained in this one word."

materials.name: Slime of Harmony
sources: Stargazer Navalia: Entranced Ingenium: Obedient Dracolion or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
materials.story: A torus that seems to possess the power of Harmony. It only has one surface. No matter where you depart, you're destined to not reach your destination. A tiny complaint would be that it is a bit sticky, as if it does not want to let you go. "All are connected and the wind of blessing breathes across the lands!"

materials.name: Dragon Scale Coral
materials.description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
materials.story: At the bottom of Lunarescent Depths, there is a diverse array of nearly a hundred coral species, among which dragon scale coral holds the greatest value. Within the coral skeleton of dragon scale coral, there is a rich concentration of Heavenly East compound. This compound serves as the finest antibiotic in the cosmos and possesses numerous other medicinal properties. Despite almost ten thousand years of efforts, humans have yet to learn how to industrially produce this compound. In front of the entrance to the Fanghu's Alchemy Commission stands a statue of dragon scale coral. Underneath it, there is an inscription that reads: "When you mistakenly believe you can control nature, always remember: Nature is the ultimate biochemist."

materials.name: The Sound and the Fury
sources: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
materials.story: As you may have realized, the majority of sounds in this world are noise, and the majority of words are meaningless combinations. Don't let these distractions sway your judgment. "Life is like a fool's dream filled with the sound and the fury, but ultimately meaningless."

materials.name: Thermal Gel
sources: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Heat dissipation is a challenge that all Intellitrons must overcome. Although Intellitrons created using different generations of technology differ significantly in terms of materials and internal structures, traditional physical heat dissipation often remains the most suitable choice for many models. "It's just like organic beings bathing in water."

materials.name: Silk Spindle
sources: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
materials.description: Tier 3 Synthesis Material
materials.story: A spindle entwined with silk threads. When the first discarded garment handcrafted by Aglaea accidentally found its way to the market, people were left in awe. What ingenious trimming! What flawless hidden seams! What masterful cutting! For a time, the entire Okhema fashion scene was swept into a frenzy of imitating Aglaea's artistry. The type of spindle she uses also became a must-have among garmentmakers, but the golden thread wound around it — exclusive to the demigod of Mnestia — cannot be replicated no matter what. "O beautiful Mnestia, grant me but one-tenth of Lady Aglaea's talent! I am willing to do anything in exchange!"

materials.name: Interdimensional Leaf
sources: Cloudford: Mara-Struck Soldiers or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
materials.story: The gravity of the planet Arivanta is not fixed. Rather, it changes all the time according to a Bode plot due to the influence of Arivanta's three moons. Ordinary life forms cannot survive such volatility, so the planet developed its unique eco-system, in which the herbal plant Interdimensional Tree is the most famous. For plants in a world where gravity is constantly subject to change, their leaves often have a hard time landing on the planet's ancient and solid ground. It is for this reason that the Interdimensional Trees tend to shake off their leaves rather late in the year. To help their leaves land, these trees, in the course of evolution, gave their leaves the ability to conduct fast short-distance warp-jumps towards the ground at frequencies that cannot be observed by naked eyes. Even so, not every leaf gets to land on the ground. Those lucky enough to make it watch others rise into the sky and burn as they are devoured by the atmosphere. "Wow."

materials.name: Phase Flame
sources: Robot Settlement: Automatons or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Sserkal, #29 of the Genius Society, only lived 29 days by human measures of time. Despite that, she put her short life as a spider to good use, inventing new technologies that would have taken the spider-kind thousands of years to develop. Of all her inventions, the most famous must be the technique known as Phase Change. What people don't know is that this technique was first applied to experiments with ions. She successfully created Phase Flame, which almost immediately changed to another phase. By the time the Flame returned to the Sserkal Phase, our genius had already passed away. She tried to harness the Flame but had too little time to do so. Thus, the Phase Flame continued to change between phases across different worlds, leaving behind the seeds of flame. "Sserkal's life was remarkable. She was smart, kindhearted, and above all, humble. She remained curious and inquisitive, asking her final question in the club on the last day of her life, the answer to which has not been found to this day."

materials.name: Tear Crystal of Glorious Death
sources: Corridor of Fading Echoes: Everwinter Shadewalkers or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
materials.story: A Mourning Actor took a gondola and rowed towards a silent world of barrenness, humming an elegy for civilizations long gone. Not a single soul could be found at the site of the doomsday battlefield, but like nacre, the world that had turned into ashes gave birth to pearls of sorrow. The ghosts of the past condensed into clouds and rained down crystals like teardrops. The Actor held a fine grain of such crystal in hand and immediately heard in a dream the glorious chorus of civilizations at their height — heroes with godly might, starships like towering mountains, the whimper of stars, and the rage of the enemy. The Actor became restless in sleep, dragged into silent dreams. "Every single joy I had in my dreams breaks my heart."

materials.name: Mythus Knots
sources: Rivet Town: Imaginary Weavers or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
materials.story: To make the divine revelations of the Mythus even more mysterious, the History Fictionologists whipped up something known as Mythus Knots that contain a blend of rumors, secrets, legends, and myths. Historians would then blend such misinformation into what was supposed to be certain and rigid historical facts, with the aim to bring about a future of uncertainty for the universe. According to the History Fictionologists, the course of history is limited by the "narrative drive" in the minds of its observers. If something can be done to mix myths into facts, the universe will be covered in the "mist of uncertainty," allowing it to escape the calamity that is doomed to happen. "Scammers try to predict the future themselves, but prophets resort to higher powers."

materials.name: Weary
sources: The Reverie Hotel: Memory Zone Meme "Heartbreaker" or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
materials.story: I'm tired of writing. I'm done with it. "This is what is called 'weariness.'"

materials.name: Mechanical Cube
sources: The Reverie Hotel: Dreamjolt Troupe's Mr. Domescreen or other enemies
materials.description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
materials.story: According to legend, this is the heart of a prominent Intellitron leader, containing the Ultimate Source Code, the essence of all inorganic life. Scholars at the Intelligentsia Guild believe that this code holds the key to unraveling the mysteries of inorganic life. "It may also be the pathway for demons to return to the mortal world."

materials.name: Fresh Seed of Dawn
sources: Enemies such as Furiae Warriors drop "Strife Ruins Castrum Kremnos"
materials.description: Tier 4 Synthesis Material
materials.story: Legend has it that Amphoreus once hosted a beauty pageant where several renowned beauties each plucked a fruit from the golden apple tree. Mnestia declared that the contestant who returned the following year with their golden apple still intact would be deemed the most beautiful. When the year passed, none of the contestants succeeded in the trial — even the finest golden apples had rotted, just as even the most radiant faces inevitably fade with time. But in the third year, an ordinary-looking peasant girl returned, not with an apple, but with a new seedling. She explained that she had been deeply saddened by the golden apple's decay and had carefully gathered the seeds from the rotting fruit, planting them to nurture a new tree. Moved by her actions, Georios appeared and urged Mnestia to crown the peasant girl as the most beautiful contestant. Mnestia, however, was reluctant, unable to see any beauty in the girl. At that moment, Georios called upon Oronyx to cover Mnestia's eyes with the veil of night. The instant Mnestia lost their sight, they perceived the brilliance of the peasant girl's heart and joyfully awarded her the title. "Agy, doesn't this legend sound like your story?" "Heh... a beautiful tale, indeed."
